Author: XivHub
Name: RetainerReach
Punchline: Shows all your retainers' items in one grid and retrieves them in one click. Needs AllaganTools.
Description:
Shows your character's and all your retainers' inventories in one icon grid, laid out like the game's own. Select items and press Retrieve: it summons each retainer holding them at a nearby Summoning Bell and moves the items into your bags. You can search by name, filter by category or crafting material, save pulls you repeat as presets, and retrieve from chat with /retrieve.

Needs AllaganTools (also called Allagan Market or InventoryTools) installed and enabled; RetainerReach reads retainer inventories from it. It acts in game for you, using the bell and retrieving items, so use it at your own risk under the game's Terms of Service.
